title: Laravel Boost MCP for local dev
summary: Local developers can use Laravel Boost MCP in Cursor with Laragon, including AI guidelines and skills wired for this repository.
changes: Install laravel/boost and add boost.json for Cursor MCP integration.
Add Cursor AI guidelines and Laravel, Tailwind, and testing skills under .cursor/skills.
Document Laragon PHP 8.4 requirement for boost:mcp in AGENTS.md.
version_rationale: Patch release: local development tooling and documentation only; no production application behaviour change.
validation: composer install on PHP 8.4+ with laravel/boost dependency resolved.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main after filling release notes.
known_limitations: boost:mcp requires PHP 8.4 or newer; Laragon Apache may need a PHP 8.4 FastCGI handler until Laragon ships 8.4 mod_php.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. To remove Laravel Boost, revert the composer dependency, boost.json, Cursor skills, and AGENTS.md guidance from this release.
provenance: Defined by the Laravel Boost MCP setup for MyAPES Account issue #175.
